verdict.rationale: Bruno AI offers in-editor AI assistance (ghost-text suggestions, script/test/docs generation, an AI chat sidebar that understands the context of open requests/collections) which can surface suggestions while working with API data, but this is framed as code/script/documentation generation rather than analytic 'insights' derived from response data or usage patterns. missing for 10: no evidence of AI analyzing response payloads, traffic patterns, or providing data-driven insights/trends; no independent hands-on validation of the AI features' quality.
